settings.label: Wordmark
settings.info: Set in the heading face in the header and the footer. Leave empty to use the site name.

settings.label: Logo
settings.info: Replaces the wordmark in the header and the footer. The wordmark stays as its alt text.

settings.label: Tagline
settings.default: Music and dance in Marlowe Cross
settings.info: The line under the wordmark in the footer.

settings.label: Reveal on scroll
settings.info: Cards fade up and headings rise in, word by word, as they enter view. Never the first screen.

settings.label: Ask button
settings.info: The theme takes requests, not bookings. Link sends every ask button to your own enrolment page.

settings.label: Ask link
settings.info: Where the ask button goes when it follows a link, and without JavaScript.

settings.label: Confirm line
settings.default: We reply within two working days.

settings.label: Portal link
settings.info: Your own parent or student portal. Leave empty to hide the link.

settings.label: Accreditation lines
settings.info: One registration or membership per line. Printed in the footer and the story.

settings.label: Subject label
settings.info: What the school calls the way it groups classes: Subject, Style, Department.

settings.label: Phone
settings.info: Printed as typed; the call links drop the spaces.
